scope: Prostate carcinoma predictive/prognostic biomarkers. Internal substrate only.

biomarker_records.biomarker: Diagnostic IHC triad (basal markers / AMACR / NKX3.1)
biomarker_records.scoring: Basal markers (p63, HMWCK) absent in invasive carcinoma; AMACR/P504S positive; NKX3.1 confirms prostatic lineage.
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: Diagnostic, not therapy-gating; confirms carcinoma on small foci and establishes prostatic origin in metastases.

biomarker_records.biomarker: Germline / somatic HRR alterations (BRCA2, BRCA1, ATM, others)
biomarker_records.scoring: Pathogenic HRR-gene alteration present vs absent; BRCA2 most actionable.
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: Gates PARP inhibitor therapy in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (some indications combined with androgen-receptor-pathway inhibitors); BRCA2 also informs prognosis and screening.
biomarker_records.companion_dx_basis: PARP-inhibitor trials in mCRPC / FDA companion dx

biomarker_records.scoring: MMR loss / MSI-high (less common in prostate than CRC).
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: Gates tumor-agnostic checkpoint inhibitor therapy in the minority of MSI-H prostate cancers.
Adverse prognostic marker; associated with aggressive disease and informs trial eligibility (PI3K/AKT pathway).
PSMA positivity gates PSMA-targeted radioligand therapy in mCRPC and guides PSMA PET staging.
biomarker_records.companion_dx_basis: PSMA radioligand therapy approvals / PSMA PET

biomarker_records.scoring: ERG expression as surrogate for the fusion (~50% of prostate cancers).
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: Lineage/diagnostic marker; ERG positivity confirms neoplastic prostatic epithelium. Not currently therapy-gating but biologically defining.

notes: HRR/BRCA (PARP) and PSMA (radioligand) are the therapy-gating headliners; the IHC triad and ERG are diagnostic/lineage. ctDNA-based somatic HRR testing is a Liquid Pulse crossover. Verify PARP and PSMA indications at write time — both are active areas.
